summary.text: VEDAL AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 1986-12-08. VEDAL AS is engaged in engineering and contracting, property development, and other industrial and trading activities, including participation in other companies and related activities. Its website states that it develops, plans and carries out property and construction projects in close cooperation with its customers. It was previously named Egil Vedal AS until 1998-07-25. Its main industry code is 41.000: construction of residential and non-residential buildings. The register shows 12 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 32 413 000 NOK and the annual result was 94 651 000 NOK; operating income was up from 31 044 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 100 767 000 NOK in 2024 to 94 651 000 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 129 437 000 NOK in 2024 to 143 757 000 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is vedal.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn profiles. Its website links to a careers page or job board. The latest news on its own website is "Vedal vil ligge i front på sikkerhet: – Vi må forebygge før skadene skjer" from 2026-10-29. The registered employee count went from 11 on 2026-02-13 to 12 on 2026-03-13.
